name: Do not show Windows tips
description: Enables the Group Policy 'Do not show Windows tips' (Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > Cloud Content) by setting DisableSoftLanding = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent. Only effective on Enterprise and Education editions.
rationale: Removes contextual pop-up tips that explain how to use Windows, which are promotional or distracting on a configured machine.
effects: Users no longer see Windows tips.
sideEffects: Contextual help pop-ups for new Windows features are not shown.
Applies to every user account on the device.
notes: Policy definition CloudContent.admx, policy DisableSoftLanding (class Machine): enabled value 1, disabled value 0.

The policy explanation states that it only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs, and the Policy CSP (Experience/AllowWindowsTips) lists it as not applicable to Pro. WinLean therefore marks the rule Unsupported on other editions instead of writing a value that has no effect.
Requires Administrator rights (the value is stored under HKLM).

references.title: Microsoft Learn - Policy CSP Experience: AllowWindowsTips (group policy mapping: CloudContent.admx, DisableSoftLanding)
